evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

observations.why: Quinton issues a directive mandating monthly rehearsals — a command enacted from a position of authority.
Xena records the cadence as a mandated schedule parameter, ratifying the directive's authority-ranking structure.
Assigning Quinton as owner ratifies the authority-ranking structure — naming who holds command over the rehearsals.

mints.name: DirectiveOwnerAllocation
mints.title: Owner and cadence allocated by directive
mints.frame: Is authority being enacted by assigning ownership and mandating a schedule, rather than by negotiation or consensus?
